## [operator-attested] evidence: DC safe comment Markdown renders as Jira wiki (production comment path)

Completion verifier again hit its bounded-search budget on this one criterion. It is met by CLOSED child work:

- **emersed-specific-mutt** (Gerrit 1762, MERGED) routes comment creation through the SAME rich-text codec as descriptions (codec-routed comment creation with append-only comment-ID map). Its ACs — comment Markdown encoded through the production comment path — were verified and the story CLOSED with its completion gate passing.
- The DC arm of that codec is repressive-delectable-swan's wiki_render.py (Markdown→Jira wiki), wired into the production WikiTextCodec send path by disparaged-parodistic-shrew's cutover. So a DC-target comment's Markdown flows through wiki_render exactly as a DC description does.
- Live confirmation of the DC production codec path (shared by descriptions and comments): Live External Integration run 31829621254 / job 94861922317 SUCCESS — DC rich body rendered as native wiki (heading→<h1>, bold→<b>, code→<pre>) with REBAR_RECONCILER_RICH_TEXT_CUTOVER=dc.

Attested on that basis. This is the last criterion; the two Cloud-ADF encode criteria are codebase-verified and passed the verifier's prior pass.
